purpose: Remediation receipt for the runtime-privilege and audit-trigger gaps in railway-audit-catalog-2026-10-09.json.

negativeTestNotes: GRANT SELECT ON users TO PUBLIC is accepted with the warning 'no privileges were granted': truenote_app holds no grant option, so nothing changes.
TRUNCATE security_events as the owner is refused first by the siem_delivery_outbox foreign key; the BEFORE TRUNCATE trigger sits behind it.

A first run of these tests included SET ROLE postgres, which succeeds only because the session user is the superuser; truenote_app is not a member of postgres (pg_has_role = false). That test was removed; the transaction was rolled back and both triggers were confirmed enabled afterwards.
